CampfireCold.collider_note: Two stump seats only; stones / ash are walk-over (no collider).
CampfireCold.notes: Cold campfire in the wagon clearing: ring of 9 stones, ash, charred logs, two stump seats, kindling pile, two empty bottles (no labels).

LogBench.collider_note: One box along the seat (5.2 x 0.5 x 0.48).
LogBench.notes: Fallen-log bench by the campfire: sawn flat seat, root plate at one end, branch stubs.

BlockedTunnelMouth.front: Unity +X (Blender -X): the cliff is on the -X side
BlockedTunnelMouth.collider_note: Portal wall box + rock-fill box + spill hull: no way through.
BlockedTunnelMouth.notes: Old single-track rail tunnel portal (stone voussoir arch, concrete face, wing walls) completely filled with rocks; rails come out from under the rocks. Terrain check (heightmap v02): ground rises steeply toward local -X, so the face looks to local +X.

Grave.front: head end (cross / stone) at Blender +Y = Unity -Z
Grave.collider_note: Low box over the mound/fence (1.0 x 1.9 x 0.5) + post box for the cross.
Grave.notes: A: wooden Orthodox cross with a little roof, grass mound, wreath. B: dark granite headstone with stone kerb and flowers. C: blue-painted iron fence (ogradka) with a metal cross, small bench and table.

Standpipe.notes: Soviet street water column (vodorazbornaya kolonka): cast-iron column, lever handle, spout with bucket hook, concrete pad.
Standpipe.variant_rule: A green, B blue (stable hash of id % 2)

FishingNets.collider_note: None (line visuals have no blocking collider per data).
FishingNets.notes: Net hung between two leaning stakes on the river bank, cork floats on the head rope, lead line at the bottom, two torn holes.

NetDryingRack.collider_note: Two thin boxes on the trestles; net has none.
NetDryingRack.notes: Two X-trestles with a pole, net drying over it on both sides, cork floats, one float line hanging.

ReedClump.notes: Pond-margin reeds with cattails; A green, B taller and drier.

ATM.front: Unity +Z (Blender -Y); data gives no facing - check on the plaza
ATM.notes: Free-standing ATM pillar, blank top lightbox, no brand or text.

BigScreen.front: Unity +Z (Blender -Y) must face the data rot direction (270 = south onto the plaza)
BigScreen.notes: LED screen on the podium edge between the towers, abstract blue / yellow geometric picture as in the approved plaza reference (no text, no logo). The screen colours are emissive swatches. DATA NOTE: with the box convention the placeholder ran N-S across the stair; place with Euler(0, 90 - rot_deg, 0) so it runs E-W and faces south.

BollardYellow.notes: Steel plaza bollard, yellow, two white reflective bands, dome top, base flange.

CourtyardGate.notes: Closed double gate of black wrought iron with an arched top, spear finials, scroll rings; no text. Sits between the two GatePier models.

GatePier.notes: Brick gate pier with corner pilasters, stone plinth and cap, iron lantern (emissive warm glass) on top.

HedgeTrimmed_2p8.notes: Boxwood, flat top, near-sharp corners, low stone planter kerb.

HedgeTrimmed_29p4.notes: Same hedge as HedgeTrimmed_2p8, built at the full 29.4 m length (no stretching).

MonumentTramduro.front: figure faces Unity +Z (Blender -Y) = data rot direction (270 = the boulevard, south)
MonumentTramduro.collider_note: Round podium as 3 stacked boxes (walkable steps) + drum box + figure box.
MonumentTramduro.notes: Golden cartoon leader (round glasses, hair tuft, suit, right arm raised in a wave) on a low dark granite drum and a round podium of 3 steps, D 8.8 m as in the data notes and the approved plaza picture (wider than the 4.8 m placeholder box). Parody without likeness to real people. ~11.8 m total.

PoliceBooth.front: door at Unity +Z (Blender -Y); data gives no facing
PoliceBooth.notes: Small glazed police booth: navy lower panels, white fascia with a blue band, blue roof beacon; no text.

RoundBenchFlowerbed.collider_note: Box 3.6 x 3.6 x 0.48 for the bed + 8 low boxes for the seat ring.
RoundBenchFlowerbed.notes: Round wooden bench ring around a raised flowerbed (no tree), as in the approved plaza reference. A red / yellow, B purple / white / pink.
RoundBenchFlowerbed.variant_rule: alternate A/B along the plaza rows

PalletStack.notes: Two stacks of empty wooden pallets (8 and 6 high), slightly uneven.

FuelPumpSingle.collider_note: Island box 1.2 x 2.4 x 0.15 + dispenser box 0.55 x 0.95 x 1.85 + 2 bollard boxes.
FuelPumpSingle.notes: Fuel island (rounded kerb, yellow end bollards) with one double-sided dispenser: displays, nozzles, hoses. No text.
FuelPumpSingle.variant_rule: one variant per station (all 3 Downtown pumps the same, e.g. B); A red, B blue, C green - no brand

FuelPumpDouble.collider_note: Island box + 2 dispenser boxes + 2 bollard boxes.
FuelPumpDouble.notes: One long island, 2 dispensers serving both sides (cars N and S), kerb 0.15 m, bollards at the ends (data note). No text.
FuelPumpDouble.variant_rule: Construction station: A (red) to match C2; B / C spare

FootballGoalTornNet.front: goal mouth opens to Blender +Y = Unity -Z (toward the pitch for both data goals, rot 90 / 270, box convention)
FootballGoalTornNet.collider_note: Boxes for the two posts and the crossbar only (net does not block).
FootballGoalTornNet.notes: Pipe goal, off-white paint with rusty feet, back stanchions, torn and sagging net with holes and a hanging flap.

WatchTower.front: ladder and door on Unity +Z (Blender -Y); data gives no facing
WatchTower.collider_note: 4 leg boxes, platform box (walkable) and cabin box.
WatchTower.notes: Border watch tower at the Rough KPP: steel legs with X-bracing, timber cabin with a window band, pyramid roof, searchlight, ladder. Military green / dark grey, no insignia.

LeaveCountryButton.front: button face looks along local +X (Unity +X, Blender -X) = data rot direction (270 = south, toward the arriving van)
LeaveCountryButton.collider_note: Box 0.3 x 0.3 x 1.3. Keeps W76LeaveCountryButton on the root.
LeaveCountryButton.notes: Hazard-striped steel post with a slanted control box and a big red mushroom button (slight glow). No text on the model.

NeonHeartSign.notes: Pink neon heart tube (emissive) with wall stand-offs and a small transformer box; plane = X/Z, wall side Blender +Y. Data box stands on the ground: lift it ~2.3 m onto the club wall.

SlidingGateSteel.collider_note: Box 8.4 x 0.2 x 3.2 (closed, blocks the road).
SlidingGateSteel.notes: One heavy steel sliding gate: tube frame, vertical ribs proud on both faces, red / white striped infill, bottom rollers. Pairs with GateGuideRail to the east.

GateGuideRail.collider_note: Low box 6.9 x 0.3 x 0.2 (+ post box at the far end).
GateGuideRail.notes: Ground guide rail for the sliding gate: concrete strip, steel rail with support rollers, end stop and a roller guide post.

AirWaterPost.notes: Fuel-station air / water post: cabinet, blank display, coiled air and water hoses. No text.

PricePylonBlank.notes: Fuel price pylon without text (v02 par. 11): double-sided cabinet with a red header, a round colour mark and blank dark price plates with colour tabs.

BioToilet.notes: Portable plastic toilet: ribbed shell, translucent white roof, door with vents and latch, vent pipe. A blue, B green, C orange.
BioToilet.variant_rule: construction: A blue x2, C orange x1, B green x1; port portable_toilet: A

SiteBin.notes: Fuel-station litter bin: galvanised square body, green flap lid, short legs.

ClothesLine.notes: Workers' clothes line at the site huts: three T-posts, two sagging lines, overalls, shirts, towels.

FireBarrel.notes: Rusty steel drum used as a fire barrel on two bricks: glowing vent holes, charred wood sticking out, embers on top (emissive).

FormworkPanels.notes: Two stacks of framed formwork panels (red steel frames, yellow plywood faces) on timber bearers.

FormworkShields.notes: Three stacks of timber board shields (planks nailed on battens) on bearers.

FormworkStack.notes: Stack of yellow timber formwork beams (H20-type) with red ends on three bearers.

GravelPile.notes: Heap of crushed stone with a few larger stones at the foot.

SandPile.notes: Heap of building sand with a shovel stuck in it.

IceChest.notes: Fuel-station ice chest / freezer: white body with a blue band, blue lid with handle, dark base. No text.

PalletBricks.notes: Four pallets of strapped red bricks; B has one pallet half emptied.

PalletBlocks.notes: Four pallets of strapped grey concrete blocks; B has one pallet emptied.

PipeStackSite.notes: Pyramid of six pipes (3-2-1) on timber chocks; A dark steel, B orange PVC.
PipeStackSite.variant_rule: A steel, B orange PVC sewer pipes (mix on site)

RebarBundles.notes: Five tied bundles of rebar on three bearers, bar ends sticking out, a few loose bars on top.

ScrapMetalPile.collider_note: Convex hull of the base heap.
ScrapMetalPile.notes: Heap of scrap: rusty base, bent sheets, pipes, an I-beam, a wheel with tyre, a painted panel.

SmokingShelter.collider_note: 4 post boxes, back-wall box, roof box.
SmokingShelter.notes: Workers' smoking shelter (kurilka): steel posts, red profiled mono-pitch roof, galvanised half-walls, bench, red ash bucket with sand.

TyreStack.notes: A: five stacked truck tyres. B: three stacked plus one leaning.

WaterTank.notes: Vertical plastic water tank with ribs, top hatch, outlet valve, on a concrete pad.
WaterTank.variant_rule: A blue (3.6 m), B white (3.2 m)

WheelWash.collider_note: Two ramp hulls + a grate box at 0.3 m (van drives over).
WheelWash.notes: Drive-over wheel-wash grate with ramps at both ends (drive along X), yellow frame, spray pipes, low blue pump box on the side.

BigBags.notes: Three white woven bulk bags (FIBC) with corner lift loops and tied spouts, one with a blue band.

MooringBollard.notes: Cast-iron mooring bollard on a bolted base plate, black with a yellow painted head rim.

RubberFender.front: rubber face to Unity +Z (Blender -Y) = the water side (verified on all 10 data fenders: box convention local +Z points to the sea)
RubberFender.notes: D-section rubber quay fender on steel back plates with a yellow-painted top angle. Intended to hang on the quay face: lower by ~1.0 m (top flush with the deck) and push ~0.2 m outward if it floats in front of the edge.

CableReel.notes: Wooden cable drum on its edge; A black cable, B orange cable with a loose end.

OilDrum.notes: 200 L steel drum with rolling hoops and bung caps. A blue, B red, C yellow.

Pallets.notes: Six stacks of empty pallets of different heights.

PipeStackPort.notes: Pyramid of 15 large steel pipes (6-5-4) on timber chocks, some rusty, some galvanised.

WaterTowerPort.collider_note: 4 leg boxes, riser box, tank hull (full, solid per data).
WaterTowerPort.notes: Old steel water tower on four braced legs: pale sage tank r 4.6 m with a catwalk and railing, conical roof, central riser pipe, ladder. Not the Hamlet Rozhnovsky tower (that is WATER-TOWER-ASTRA-001).

PipeManifold.front: built to the data polyline (U-run): legs at local x = +-11 m reaching 2.48 m toward the tanks (data +y = north), run along y = -2.48
PipeManifold.collider_note: None needed (low pipe, 0.65 m) or one box per straight run.
PipeManifold.notes: Low yellow product pipe on H-supports from the two tanks: polyline [[1287.45,655.2],[1287.45,650.24],[1309.45,650.24],[1309.45,655.2]] around pos (1298.45, 652.72); flanges, two gate valves with red handwheels near the tanks. Data has size null -> builder made a 1 m cube.

BridgeBarrier.front: boom along Blender Y (= data size[1] 6.4 m across the road); post at the Blender +Y end (Unity -Z)
BridgeBarrier.collider_note: None (data solid = false); add a trigger if the KPP logic needs one.
BridgeBarrier.notes: Closed red / white striped boom barrier of the island KPP: post with motor box and counterweight, boom rest fork at the far end.

FictionalNuclearMissile.collider_note: Missile body box + collar ring as 4 boxes.
FictionalNuclearMissile.notes: Cartoon missile rising from an open silo: concrete collar with yellow / black hazard ring, two blast doors folded open, white body with red nose and fins, dark bands. No symbols or text.

GoldStatue.front: figure faces Unity +Z (Blender -Y); facing convention gives east for rot 0 - suggest yaw 180 (Unity) so it faces the lawn / south
GoldStatue.notes: Same golden cartoon leader as the Downtown monument, 3.3 m on a 0.4 m dark plinth. Stands ON StepPedestal (same pos): lift by 1.3 m.

StepPedestal.notes: Three square travertine steps with dark granite edge bands; carries GoldStatue.

GolfGreen.collider_note: None (raised 8 cm; walkable). Flag pin optional thin box.
GolfGreen.notes: Joke mini-golf putting green: oval green on a fringe, cup, flag pin, balls; B with a small sand bunker, C with a little bridge-less water edge stone ring. Red flags, no numbers.
GolfGreen.variant_rule: one per data green (green1 A, green2 B, green3 C)

PorticoSteps.front: climbs toward Blender -Y = Unity +Z (north, to the palace door at y 812.5)
PorticoSteps.notes: White travertine stair of the palace portico: 5 steps (0.18 m) and a landing, cheek blocks with urns.

PresidentialSpeechStage.notes: Stage platform: pleated red skirt with gold trim, light deck, red carpet runner from the steps to the lectern, two flag stands with plain red / gold flags at the back.

PresidentialLectern.front: front panel to Blender +Y = Unity -Z (south, the audience); speaker stands on the Blender -Y side
PresidentialLectern.notes: Dark wood lectern with a red front panel and gold trim, slanted reading desk, two microphones. No emblem. Stands ON the stage (same area): lift by 0.8 m.

SpeechPlatformSteps.front: climbs toward Blender -Y = Unity +Z (north, up onto the stage); top = 0.8 m
SpeechPlatformSteps.notes: Four steps up to the stage with the red carpet runner and brass rope posts.
